summary:
**BOO-YAH! Week 7 Just Took Us to School!**

Let me tell you something about mastab24's 77.98-point beatdown of Langland—that wasn't a fantasy matchup, that was a demolition derby! Geno Smith throwing up 23.5 points and Quinshon Judkins rumbling for 22.9 has mastab24 looking cooler than the other side of the pillow right now. Meanwhile, Langland rolled out Emeka Egbuka and Jeremiyah Love who combined for a big fat ZERO—and I mean goose egg, zilch, nada! That's like showing up to a championship game with half your team stuck in traffic. Tre Tucker tried his best with 18.8 points, but homie, that's like bringing a water gun to a bazooka fight!

Speaking of getting taken to school, Tishathefish put on an absolute CLINIC against briankibler with 150.24 points! Jaxon Smith-Njigba was out there catching everything like he had Velcro gloves—26.8 points!—while Bucky Irving added 23.5 of his own. Tishathefish is averaging 125.7 on the season, and that's not luck, people, that's DOMINANCE. Meanwhile, briankibler's sitting there with Mason Taylor's 22.7 points thinking "what could've been," but when your wide receivers Efton Chism III and Savion Williams are combining for 8.7 points, you might as well have been playing with one hand tied behind your back!

Now let's talk about the nail-biter of the week—PrinceofPizza escaping with a 5.08-point victory over mjgrana! This was tighter than a pair of skinny jeans after Thanksgiving dinner! Zay Flowers showed up with 23.7 points for the Prince, but Bryce Young at quarterback with 5.4? That's like ordering a pizza and getting the box without the pie! On the flip side, mjgrana had Joe Burrow slinging it for 28.9 and Christian McCaffrey doing his thing with 19.0, but Sam LaPorta's 2.3-point performance? Man, he must've thought the game was optional! When you're on a two-week cold streak and lose by five points, that's gonna sting worse than lemon juice on a paper cut!

And somebody needs to check on iwmrichfulton, who's now on a three-week cold streak and just got steamrolled by cosmohouck 122.36 to 68.5! Cosmohouck is sitting pretty at #1 in the power rankings averaging 147.2 points per game—that's video game numbers, baby! Drake Maye with 27.4 and Trey McBride with 22.1 had cosmohouck cruising like a Cadillac on the highway. Meanwhile, iwmrichfulton starting BOTH C.J. Stroud AND Jacoby Brissett at quarterback for 16.5 points each? That's the fantasy football equivalent of ordering two medium pizzas when you could've had one large—it just doesn't add up! This matchup was like watching Mike Tyson versus your little cousin—we knew how it was gonna end before the bell even rang!

This week reminded me of that classic scene in "Space Jam" when the Monstars stole all the talent from the NBA players—except in this league, cosmohouck, Tishathefish, and Shogunation ARE the Monstars, and they're straight up stealing everybody's lunch money! With blowouts bigger than a Fourth of July fireworks show and only one close game all week, Week 7 was as lopsided as a see-saw with Shaq on one end. As cool as the other side of the pillow? More like as COLD as the other side of the pillow for those teams on losing streaks! **BOO-YAH!**
